out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. Follow up in 10 days for CFM credentials obtained.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Clean and Dry Location
violations.observation: Food stored in a wet or soiled location as follows: oranges stored under hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food in a clean, dry location. CDI removed from hand sink area.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. Observed Food Handler Certifications for multiple staff, but establishment prepares food rather than serving catered food, so full CFM is required.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program within 10 days. Follow up in 10 days.
